description: This file defines the internal class StreamConsumerCollection within the Orleans.Streams namespace. It manages a collection of stream consumers such as adding, removing, and querying consumers, as well as handling their activity status and disposal.

classes.name: StreamConsumerCollection
classes.description: A collection managing multiple stream consumers, tracking activity, and providing methods for consumer management and inactivity checks.

methods.name: StreamConsumerCollection
methods.description: Constructor initializing the collection with current time.

methods.name: AddConsumer
methods.description: Adds a new consumer to the collection with specified subscription id, stream id, consumer extension, and filter data.

methods.name: RemoveConsumer
methods.description: Removes a consumer based on subscription id and disposes its cursor if found.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a consumer with the specified subscription id exists.

methods.name: TryGetConsumer
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a consumer's data by subscription id.

methods.name: AllConsumers
methods.description: Returns an enumeration of all consumer data objects.

methods.name: DisposeAll
methods.description: Disposes all consumers' cursors and clears the collection.

methods.name: RefreshActivity
methods.description: Updates the last activity timestamp to the current time.

methods.name: IsInactive
methods.description: Determines if the collection is inactive based on last activity and consumer state.
